input.synthetic_input_scope: Deterministic public image workload, not a BIL product trace

attribution: I-SR/I-DR is Memory interface increment at fixed ring layout
I-AR/I-SR is arena increment at fixed ring layout
I-AR/I-DR is net Memory strategy versus persistent ordinary System ring
Direct ratios use corresponding same-block tasks; do not add gains across contrasts

storage.input_policy: One immutable preloaded complete PPM vector common to all variants; each frame copies RGB payload into the same persistent RGB workspace
storage.workspace: Three persistent allocations per full batch, 64-byte requested alignment, min(H,3) gray rows for ring
storage.steady_state_provider_allocations: Measured pre-cleanup count minus post-workspace-creation count; expected zero for all variants

included: complete per-frame output sum and FNV digest
timing.formal: Only full total start/end clocks; no phase clocks, close probes, output file or output capture
timing.functional_capture: --verify-output marks diagnostic=true, copies final output during task, writes PGM after total. Never pool with formal
timing.fixed_ordinary_baseline_limit: Persistent direct System already has zero steady-state provider calls; source-to-RGB copy is a controlled contract, not a claim of the fastest conceivable image API

functional_qualification.coverage: 12 dimensions x 6 provider/layout pairs x capture+formal, plus 18 worker/input/output failure cases
